verdict.rationale: Make's docs show that webhooks create a URL that external apps or services can call to trigger scenario execution, with optional scheduled processing of queued webhook data. Custom app components also include Webhooks, so event-driven triggering from connected apps is documented at the mechanism level. However, the pack never shows native per-app event triggers for the story's examples (new record, new message, new email, form submission), so this rests mainly on generic webhooks. Missing for 10: documented native app-event triggers (watch new record, message, email, form submission), and independent or hands-on corroboration of event-triggered runs.
